summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K furnishing exhibits on consolidated capitalization and earnings ratios as of July 31, 2026, as part of its ongoing reporting obligations. The filing includes subordinated debentures, common and preferred equity, and ratios of earnings to fixed charges under IFRS. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is involved; it is routine financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing simply provides updated capitalization data and earnings coverage ratios for investors, with no imminent corporate event to monitor.
